name.description: The name of the PolarDB instance.

i18n.en-US: The name of the PolarDB instance.

db_instance_id.description: The ID of an existing PolarDB instance. If set, no new instance will be created.

i18n.zh-Hans: 已有PolarDB实例的ID。如果设置，则不会创建新实例。
i18n.en-US: The ID of an existing PolarDB instance. If set, no new instance will be created.

engine.description: The database engine type. Valid values: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLServer.

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据库引擎类型。有效值：MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLServer。
i18n.en-US: The database engine type. Valid values: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLServer.

storage.description: The storage size of the instance in GB.

i18n.en-US: The storage size of the instance in GB.

storage_type.description: The storage type of the instance. Valid values: local_ssd, cloud_ssd, cloud_essd.

i18n.en-US: The storage type of the instance. Valid values: local_ssd, cloud_ssd, cloud_essd.

vswitch_id.description: The ID of the VSwitch for network configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于网络配置的交换机ID。
i18n.en-US: The ID of the VSwitch for network configuration.

security_ips.description: List of security IPs that are allowed to access the instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 允许访问实例的安全IP列表。
i18n.en-US: List of security IPs that are allowed to access the instance.

parameters.description: Map of database parameters to set.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要设置的数据库参数映射。
i18n.en-US: Map of database parameters to set.

databases.description: Map of databases to create. Key is database name, value is database configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要创建的数据库映射。键为数据库名称，值为数据库配置。
i18n.en-US: Map of databases to create. Key is database name, value is database configuration.

accounts.description: Map of accounts to create. Key is account name, value is account configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要创建的账号映射。键为账号名称，值为账号配置。
i18n.en-US: Map of accounts to create. Key is account name, value is account configuration.

use_account_database_binding.description: Whether to use alibabacloudstack_polardb_account_database_binding resource instead of alibabacloudstack_polardb_account_privilege for account privileges.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否使用alibabacloudstack_polardb_account_database_binding资源替代alibabacloudstack_polardb_account_privilege来管理账号权限。
i18n.en-US: Whether to use alibabacloudstack_polardb_account_database_binding resource instead of alibabacloudstack_polardb_account_privilege for account privileges.

db_connection_prefix.description: The connection prefix for the database connection.

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据库连接的连接前缀。
i18n.en-US: The connection prefix for the database connection.

port.description: The port number for the database connection.

i18n.en-US: The port number for the database connection.

encryption_key.description: The key ID of the disk encryption in the same region.

i18n.zh-Hans: 同区域磁盘加密的密钥ID。
i18n.en-US: The key ID of the disk encryption in the same region.

tags.description: Tags to assign to the resources.

i18n.en-US: Tags to assign to the resources.

db_instance_class.description: The instance type/class of the PolarDB instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: PolarDB 实例的实例类型/规格。
i18n.en-US: The instance type or class of the PolarDB instance.

encryption.description: Whether encryption is enabled for the instance.

i18n.en-US: Whether encryption is enabled for the instance.

tde_status.description: The Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) status of the instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例的透明数据加密（TDE）状态。
i18n.en-US: The Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) status of the instance.
